about: The creatures sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

slime_attack.use: the Jelly Slime lunges: a squelch.
slime_attack.anchor: die_land_a_1.wav at gain 1; target -4 dB relative to it

slime_hit.use: the Jelly Slime struck: a squish.
slime_hit.anchor: die_land_a_1.wav at gain 1; target -5 dB relative to it

slime_die.use: the Jelly Slime bursts: a squish and a splat falling apart.
slime_die.anchor: die_land_a_1.wav at gain 1; target -2 dB relative to it
